caption: The drawing depicts an arrangement of flowers and foliage in a naturalistic style, with a woven basket visible in the upper right corner. The flowers are illustrated in various colors, including shades of pink, blue, yellow, and white, while the leaves are rendered in green with yellow and blue accents. The background features a subtle, quilted diamond pattern in light grey tones. Along the top left, bottom, and top edges, there are small, triangular, patchwork sections in red, yellow, and orange floral patterns. The composition predominantly occupies the left and center of the image, with the right side displaying the basket and additional flowers extending outward. The primary colors used in the drawing are pink, blue, yellow, green, and brown, with outlines and shading giving depth to the botanical forms.
title: Quilt (Bed Coverlet)
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
